newsitem.title: USA: CN Biosciences plans stock offering.
newsitem.headline: CN Biosciences plans stock offering.

text.p: CN Biosciences Inc said it plans to file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the sale of one million shares of common stock, including 910,000 to be sold for the account of ABS MB Limited Partnership and 90,000 to be sold by the company.

It said its largest stockholder, Warburg, Pincus Investors LP, will not be participating in the offering as a selling shareholder. As a result, it said the offering will be made only by means of a prospectus. It is planned for April.
